📌 Executive Summary

Tamilpreneur MOM Studio is a custom-engineered, end-to-end automation tool built specifically for the Tamilpreneur core team. It transforms raw meeting audio files (including .mp3, .wav, .m4a, and WhatsApp voice notes) into structured, executive-formatted Google Docs with key discussion points, decisions, assigned owners, and action deadlines in under 60 seconds.

The system eliminates manual note-taking friction, unifies team documentation under a centralized Google Drive repository (/meeting-audio), and provides 1-click sharing to Slack and WhatsApp.

🛠️ Core Engineering Achievements & Bug Fixes

1. Elimination of 15-Minute Polling Delay

  • Challenge: Original Make.com setup polled Google Drive on a 15-minute interval, causing excessive lag during live operations.
  • Solution: Migrated to an Instant Custom Webhook (ID: 4037703). Ingestion latency dropped to 0 seconds.
  • Efficiency Gain: Reduced operations consumed from 9 down to 4-7 per meeting (>50% quota conservation).

2. WhatsApp Voice Note Audio Decoding (PIPELINE_ERROR_DECODE)

  • Challenge: Chromium engines reject WhatsApp .opus / .aac ADTS voice notes with audio playback silence.
  • Solution: Implemented a high-speed local FFmpeg transcoder in Node.js (/api/transcode) converting files to standard 44.1kHz MP3 in under 150ms.

3. Broken Google Doc Link Resolution (/d//edit Fix)

  • Challenge: Initial runs produced docs.google.com/document/d//edit because the Google Docs module outputs 18.id and 18.webViewLink rather than 18.documentId.
  • Solution: Patched Scenario 7611268 blueprint via API to dynamically resolve {{ifempty(18.webViewLink; 18.id)}}. Verified end-to-end with live document ID 1v0L9I6qEHtReAEkk5BVDXOjZUQUozCcNw1_RBhunXDU.

4. Team Collaboration Architecture & Archive Hub

  • Department Categorization: Tags meetings under Tech & Product, Marketing, Community, Leadership, or General.
  • Team Archive: On-screen history tracking past meeting docs with 1-click clipboard formatting for WhatsApp/Slack channels.

👥 How Tamilpreneur Team Uses This System

✅ One-Time Setup for Team Drive Folder

To allow every team member to view and edit generated documents seamlessly:
1. Open the Google Drive /meeting-audio folder.
2. Click Share → change General Access to "Anyone with the link can view / edit".
3. Every document generated thereafter inherits this permission automatically.
